content: We evaluate with all commonly-used metrics in question generation BIBREF13: BLEU-1 (B1), BLEU-2 (B2), BLEU-3 (B3), BLEU-4 (B4) BIBREF17, METEOR (MET) BIBREF18 and ROUGE-L (R-L) BIBREF19. We use the evaluation script released by Chen2015MicrosoftCC.
